content.text: We have 4 hidden units. Input weights matrix 4x2: rows: unit0: [0,-1]; unit1: [1,0]; unit2: [0,1]; unit3: [0,0]? Wait 4x2 gives 8 numbers: 0,-1,1,0,-1,0,0,1. So rows: u0: [0,-1]; u1: [1,0]; u2: [-1,0]; u3: [0,1]. biases all zero. Output weights 2x4: 0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0 all zero. So outputs always zero. So argmax class 0 wins ties. Desired class 1 iff x0>0. But output always 0, so wrong. Need to preserve x0 circuit: which hidden units use x0? u1 has weight 1 on x0. u2 has weight -1 on x0. So x0 circuit uses u1 and u2. To override, need to zero outgoing weights of two hidden units that override x0. Since output weights all zero, no override. But we need to set two hidden units outgoing weights to zero to preserve x0? Actually we need to identify two hidden units whose outgoing weights should become zero to preserve x0 circuit. Since output weights all zero, any hidden unit outgoing weights are zero already. So no change needed. So answer NONE.
